blurb: Guests rent boats to operate on Lake Ray Hubbard. Rentals require a valid driver's license and, if born after August 31, 1993, a Texas Boater Education Certificate. Safety rules include wearing US Coast Guard approved personal flotation devices at all times and no alcohol or drug use while operating vessels.
extraNote: Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · With Trip Protection: Cancel up to 24 hours before your rental start time to receive a full refund in the form of a rental credit (gift card). · No-Shows: Reservations will be forfeited with no refund or credit. · Arriving more than 1 hour past your scheduled start time without notice is considered a no-show. - Please arrive 30 minutes early for check in and bring the credit card used to reserve and your driver's license. · All reservations are non-refundable unless Trip Protection is purchased at booking · With Trip Protection, cancel up to 24 hours in advance for full rental credit · No refund, credit, or rescheduling without Trip Protection
